title: tests.py given a test file still runs every test file
goal: python3 _tools/tests.py _tools/test_x.py passes only that file (and its pytest arguments) to pytest, not the whole _tools directory beside it, so an item check such as tests.py _tools/test_testmap.py runs that file's tests and not the full suite; a test plants a path argument and sees _tools absent from the pytest targets

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import tests as t;s={};t.run_pytest=lambda a,**k:s.setdefault('a',a) and 0;t.main(['_tools/test_testmap.py']);assert t.TOOLS not in s['a'],'tests.py runs every test file when given one'
